# First let's install the required packages
# %pip install -U 'crewai[tools]'
# Then import them
from crewai import Crew, Agent, Task
from crewai_tools.tools import WebsiteSearchTool, SerperDevTool, FileReadTool
import agentops
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from textwrap import dedent

# Initialize AgentOps client
agentops.init(
    auto_start_session=False, trace_name="CrewAI Job Posting", tags=["crewai", "job-posting", "agentops-example"]
)

web_search_tool = WebsiteSearchTool()
serper_dev_tool = SerperDevTool()
file_read_tool = FileReadTool(
    file_path="job_description_example.md",
    description="A tool to read the job description example file.",
)

metadata.objective: Configure and instantiate external tools for agent use

skill_drafts.name: AgentOps Session Initialization
skill_drafts.description: Initialize and configure AgentOps client for agent execution tracing with custom session metadata, tags, and auto-start control. Use when starting a new agent-based workflow that requires observability and debugging.
contraindications: Offline or local-only execution without telemetry
Environments where external tracing is prohibited
workflow_steps: Call agentops.init() with trace_name, tags, and auto_start_session parameters
Verify client is ready to capture traces
triggers: Starting a new CrewAI or multi-agent workflow
Need to enable session tracing and debugging
Require observability for agent actions and execution traces
constraints: AgentOps package must be installed and imported
Environment variables (e.g., API keys) must be loaded before init()
auto_start_session parameter controls whether session starts immediately or on explicit call
output_contract: AgentOps client initialized with active session context, ready to capture agent actions and traces. Session metadata (trace_name, tags) is registered and available for downstream observability.

examples.output: AgentOps session initialized with deferred start; trace_name and tags registered for later session activation
examples.notes: Deferred start allows manual control over when tracing begins

metadata.prompt: Call agentops.init() with appropriate parameters: auto_start_session (bool), trace_name (str), and tags (list). This establishes the tracing session context before agent execution begins. Ensure the AgentOps package is imported and environment is loaded.

skill_drafts.name: CrewAI Tool Integration Setup
skill_drafts.description: Import and instantiate CrewAI tools (WebsiteSearchTool, SerperDevTool, FileReadTool) with required configuration parameters. Prepares a multi-tool agent environment for task execution.
skill_drafts.objective: Configure and instantiate external tools for agent use
applicable_signals: Agent definition requires external tool dependencies
contraindications: Agents use only built-in capabilities with no external tool dependencies
Tool initialization is handled by framework defaults
workflow_steps: Instantiate WebsiteSearchTool with no required parameters
Instantiate SerperDevTool with no required parameters
Instantiate FileReadTool with file_path and description parameters
Verify all tool instances are ready for agent assignment
triggers: Building a CrewAI agent that requires web search, file I/O, or external API access
Tools need explicit initialization before agent task assignment
constraints: FileReadTool requires valid file_path parameter pointing to an accessible file
All tool instances must be created before agent binding
cautions: Ensure file_path points to an existing, readable file before FileReadTool instantiation
Tool configuration must match agent task requirements
output_contract: Tool instances created and ready for agent task assignment; tool references available for agent binding.

examples.input: Need to set up web search and file reading for a job posting analysis agent
examples.output: web_search_tool = WebsiteSearchTool(); file_read_tool = FileReadTool(file_path='job_description.md', description='Tool to read job description')
examples.notes: Tools are now ready to be passed to agent task definitions

metadata.prompt: Import the required CrewAI tool classes from crewai_tools.tools. Instantiate each tool with its configuration: WebsiteSearchTool() requires no parameters; SerperDevTool() requires no parameters; FileReadTool() requires file_path and description parameters. Ensure all tool instances are created before passing them to agent task definitions.
